about: Hand-maintained race list for Paddle Tracker, from the owner's race schedule. PaddleGuru's terms forbid automated access, so nothing here is scraped: details come from organisers' sites and public reports, and each race links to its PaddleGuru page. status 'draft — confirm' = not yet checked by the owner; 'date TBA' = next season, date not posted. Edit with: python -m src.paddle.races set <id> --date YYYY-MM-DD [--start HH:MM] [--url URL]
